scope.authorization: Local adapter fixture owned by this repository; no third-party production target is involved.

invariants.title: Manifest export preserves the minimal terminal-state violation path
invariants.summary: A validated v0.8 adapter manifest and explorer result are deterministically transformed into a client finding for the same three-step terminal-state violation detected by the local adapter regression.
invariants.impact: The manifest layer preserves the evidence needed to map a machine-discovered path into a reviewable finding without manually re-entering action names, actors, invariant metadata, scope wording, or report fields.
invariants.recommendation: For a real authorized engagement, review the adapter manifest against the written scope, keep the action and state-field mappings complete, and export only deterministic explorer results produced from the matching fixed-block adapter.
